subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Common
solution:
The correct answer is **Usual**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of "*Common*" is Usual.
 
• Usual - Habitually or typically occurring or done or customary.
 
 
• *For example : " She carried out her usual chaos."*
 
 
 
• **Common - **Occurring, found, or done often or prevalent.** **
 
 
• *For example : "They had common interests in each other."*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options :

 
 
• ​Scarce - Insufficient for the demand.

 
 
• ​*For example : "The raw supplies were scarce."*
 
 
 
• Particular - Of, relating to, or being a single person or thing.
 
 
• *For example : " The particular person I had in mind."*
 
 
 
• Individual - Single or separate.
 
 
• ​*For example : " The tiny flowers were individually beautiful."*
 
 
 
 

40:T
